condition: Mac M2 Max; original 11-4 two tasks; K192; five full paired trials; one MLX worker at a time; inherited warm filesystem; no cache reset
metric: median of 10 within-task/trial preserve_wall_s / restart_wall_s ratios
probability_note: Judgment, not a calibrated confidence interval
quality_condition: All 20 restored paths natural EOS, exact strict JSON and token IDs equal to their paired baseline
falsification: Any restored path fails quality or token equality
review_sources: formal/ raw worker calls, tokens, manager SQLite snapshots and execution logs when actually produced
PROTOCOL.md and future-plan.json bind the prospective test

strongest_known_counterexample.note: Read exact values from frozen historical summary; ratio approximately 1.102, preserving prefix was slower.

revision_rules.quality_failure: Withdraw unconditional token-equivalent resumption; inspect batch-prefill arithmetic and freeze a new correctness-focused protocol before more tests
revision_rules.ratio_above_1: Reject speed expectation for this condition; separate load, KV rebuild, decode and transaction/host delays in the model
revision_rules.ratio_below_0_70: Record interval miss despite stronger direction; recalibrate a new prediction without altering v1
revision_rules.interval_supported: Retain only the stated local condition; do not generalize to other models, stochastic sampling or production
revision_rules.late_data: Mark late; no retrospective on-time validation
